_about: Every line the Conversations MVP says or offers (docs/game-design/modes/conversations.md §8.2, with §10a applied). k = the Kutchi as shown (null for a placeholder with no Kutchi yet); en = the English (the light bulb, and the grey italic text of a placeholder); src = where the Kutchi comes from (§n = docs/language/grammar-notes.md section n; B/A ids = the Section B recording; §10a = Zafar's decisions); status: family (in the grammar notes or a family clip), decided (Zafar's §10a decision; the handout phrase, spelling still to confirm with Mum), cast (a name from the Cast), placeholder. placeholder: true means NOT family-confirmed: it shows as grey italic English, it is never tested, and it's on Mum's recording list. audio = the chunks in order, as 'fam:<clip id>' from data/family-audio.json (the voice, Mum or Zafar, is chosen at run time); [] = no clip yet (text only). whole = a whole-line clip that beats the chunks for one filler. {x} is a noun from 'nouns' (the host's word id). pic = the bubble's picture (placeholder emoji until the art exists).
